title: Jacques Marchais Museum of Tibetan Art

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: A guided walking tour through the fieldstone halls and terraced gardens of the first Himalayan-style architecture built in America. ~45 minutes. // Admission :: $20 - Members $15 Walk the hillside route that Jacques Marchais and stonemason Joseph Primiano once drove every Sunday, picking fieldstone from across Staten Island for the walls that became the Museum. Trapezoidal windows. Slate-capped doorways. A pagoda roof copied stone for stone from a Lama Temple replica built for the 1933 Chicago World's Fair.
